summary: Backend regression passed all 6 tests and direct class create/list persistence passed. Admin navigation and role-filtered lists work, but class creation does not refresh the UI and logout/login preserves the previous role's page.

integration_issues.issue: POST succeeds, but the newly created class is not shown because CreateModal refreshes by setting selected to the same value, so AdminView's selected-dependent fetch does not rerun.
App logout clears user/token but does not reset page to Dashboard. Teacher inherits the admin's Students page and displays a Students workspace instead of the teacher dashboard.

action_items: After successful admin record creation, explicitly refetch the selected collection or change a refresh key so the new class appears immediately.
Reset page to Dashboard when logging out or when a new user logs in, preventing cross-role page leakage.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateModal refresh uses setSelected(selected), which is a no-op for React state and cannot trigger the AdminView collection fetch effect.
App logout only clears localStorage and user; page remains shared state across sessions, allowing an invalid page for the newly authenticated role.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (admin navigation and role filters pass; add refresh and cross-role logout flow fail)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST API Class 2 through the admin API for persistence verification. No UI class was created because the UI refresh defect prevented confirmation; existing seeded data was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth/dashboard/role boundaries and admin create/list pass. Retest UI class creation visibility and logout admin -> teacher/student role transitions. A fresh page starts at Dashboard, but in-app logout currently preserves the prior page.
rca of the issue: AdminView fetches records in an effect keyed by selected. CreateModal's refresh callback calls setSelected(selected), which does not change state, so the successful POST is not followed by a GET. App's logout callback clears token and user but omits setPage('Dashboard'); page therefore remains Students when the next user logs in.
